runtime_status: Not used in runtime. Original full takes retained for source review and a separate Xu Chu single-hand prototype. No commercial reference game animation extracted.

C3D.AMC_alignment: AMC sample1/source time0 corresponds first stored C3D frame9; fixed offsets were tested with limb marker/joint trajectories.
C3D.interpretation: Physical foot and prop marker trajectories. A low/stable marker is a contact candidate, not literal sole height or force-plate-certified support. WEP marker names and longest pair are not documented blade tip/handle labels.

prototype_note: ASF/AMC-only frozen /tmp26fc GLB uses static target grip and foot references; it does not use the subsequently acquired C3D prop markers. Foot basis/marker geometry and target limb proportions are under diagnosis; no experimental foot/IK variant is approved.
